{"reason":"Broaden the demand-forecast-error branch with market-signal mismatch and lower its bias cutoff from 0.1 to 0.05. This fixes the eight shown mismatch-only and 0.065–0.081 false unknowns while preserving supplier-delay precedence, improving v1’s 0.708 accuracy and 0.607 recovery-rate without reducing recovered amount.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
               (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
